title: PSA: The new stop sign on 5th and Main is NOT optional
body:
I've seen 12 people run this stop sign today. TWELVE. It's been there for a week. Yes it's new. No that doesn't mean you can ignore it.

Deputy Morrison is setting up speed traps there starting Monday. Consider yourselves warned.

comments.content: There's been no stop sign there for 40 years and suddenly we need one? This is overreach.

replies.content: Mrs. Henderson got hit by a cyclist there last month
